## 5. Objects built by WP7 and their checks against the frozen sources

- V2X physics-only domain (recipe of tools/WP5_S6_run.py without L4): layer thresholds differ from results/WP5/s6_veremi.json by at most 0.0e+00; validation false alarm of the combined score 0.009967 vs WP5 S6 0.009967 (combiner max); 256586 validation rows, 161426 genuine.
- LiDAR interim calibration: 549 normal validation scans; raw threshold 0.975527 vs WP3 S1 val_fpr_0.01 threshold 0.975527; validation FA 0.0091.
- Cross runtime-test object: 150 clean dev runs (3221 rows, parts ['train', 'val']), tau 0.997717; sigma models and calibration fitted on all dev drives.
